title: Fleet adapter requirements
about: What the platform requires of a fleet adapter, one shall sentence per ID. Each requirement names the rules of package qualify that decide it, and holds in a run when every rule it names held. A requirement says no more than its rules check: a verdict is only as good as the check behind it.

requirements.text: The adapter shall load, export the contract's four functions, and let the harness run every step to the end, with no call hanging.
Every value the adapter returns shall have the shape the contract defines, and no more status reads of a mission shall reach the vendor than the contract's read budget.
Each inventory the adapter returns shall list exactly the vendor's robots, and the last shall match the vendor's own status and battery for each robot.
Each movement command shall become exactly one order on the vendor's ledger, or no order where the vendor refuses its robot.
Every order on the vendor's ledger shall carry its command's robot and target.
Each order shall end done, or failed where its robot faults, or cancelled where the platform cancelled its command; an order the vendor answers nothing about is not judged.
Every order the vendor marks done shall leave its robot at the command's target.

The mission and state the adapter reports for each command shall be the vendor's, the read count it reports shall be no lower than the reads the vendor served, a command the vendor refused shall be reported as an error coded refused, and a command the vendor holds shall be reported only as its mission or as an error coded unresolved.
